name: Strict Contact Rule
script:
import re
import frappe

def validate_phone_number(doc, method):
    if not doc.phone:
        return

    phone_number = doc.phone.strip()

    # Malaysian phone number regex: +60 followed by 8-9 digits
    malaysia_regex = r"^\+60[1-9]\d{7,8}$"

    if not re.match(malaysia_regex, phone_number):
        frappe.throw("❌ Invalid Malaysian phone number! It must start with +60 and have 8-9 digits.")

frappe.whitelist(validate_phone_number)
